Resolve the Cleveland Booker trigger from step 4, creating a token.

When Ghost Town enters, Cleveland Booker triggers.

1116-4279-6794--216.easyPrerequisites:

1116-4279-6794--216.description:

When the creature dies, Susurian Voidborn, Sek'Kuar and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Sek'Kuar ability, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token with haste.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Susurian Voidborn triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

4247-5254-6627.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
4247-5254-6627.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.

1170-2921-4030-5131--202.description:

Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Academy Researchers
When Academy Researchers dies, Fool's Demise first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the second Fool's Demise trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the first Fool's Demise trigger, returning Academy Researchers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Academy Researchers enters, it triggers, putting Fool's Demise onto the battlefield from your hand attached to Academy Researchers.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

225-851-4365-4772-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.

Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.

250-779-1479-4693-7889.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-4693-7889.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of cards in hand that is above your maximum hand size.
250-779-1479-4693-7889.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Dancing from Dark to Dawn and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Overgrown Estate ability
Resolve the Dancing from Dark to Dawn trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Dancing from Dark to Dawn triggers.
Repeat from step 4.
Proceed to your cleanup step, and discard Dakmor Salvage and any other card(s) as needed down to your maximum hand size.
The Gitrog Monster triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, as you will still be over your maximum hand size and will be required to discard again.

Resolve the Blasting Station ability.

Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodsoaked Champion enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Repeat.

Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Declare any creature as an attacker. When you do, Doom's Time Platform triggers, exiling Time Stretch from your graveyard with two time counters on it.
Move to your first extra turn.

Move to your second extra turn and repeat step 4 once.
Time Stretch's suspend ability triggers, causing you to cast it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Time Stretch, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

As Arashin Sovereign is a Lhurgoyf due to Conspiracy, Disa's first ability triggers, returning Arashin Sovereign from your graveyard to the battlefield.

Resolve the Orochi Soul-Reaver trigger, creating a Treasure token and causing you to manifest the top card of the damaged opponent's library.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the manifested card, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

Activate Cold Storage's first ability twice by paying {6}, exiling Warden of the Eye and Dockside Extortionist from the battlefield.
Activate Cold Storage by sacrificing it, returning Dockside Extortionist and Warden of the Eye from exile to the battlefield.
When Dockside Extortionist and Warden of the Eye enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least ten Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Warden of the Eye trigger, returning Cold Storage from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate ten Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {10}.
Cast Cold Storage by paying {4}.
Repeat.
If opponents control eleven or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

An opponent is unable to block and kill Burakos and Hellkite Charger.

Resolve the Burakos trigger, creating eight Treasure artifact tokens and causing the defending opponent to lose 4 life.
Activate seven Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

Su-Chi and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
